decisions.proposed_text: Các Mã Nương gyaru, quẩy hết mình nào! Một ca khúc sinh ra vì gyaru!\nChúng ta là forever☆ hội bạn Mã Nương mạnh nhất!
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use the project world/species term Mã Nương; current prose still contains forbidden Uma Musume twice.
Here 焦躁 is ordinary narrative wording meaning impatience/anxiety, not the Rushed system label; the Vietnamese prose correctly renders the sentence naturally.
力量 appears in ordinary prose as the strength supplied by bonds, not the gameplay Power stat; translating it as sức mạnh is contextually correct.
Open context-rule finding explicitly covers this prose occurrence of 焦躁 to prevent false matching to the Rushed system label.
Open context-rule finding explicitly covers adjectival prose 光明 so it is not falsely treated as a Skill-title match.

decisions.proposed_text: Sáng thì buồn ngủ, bữa trưa thì ngon, tối thì mệt. Chẳng có gì cả.\nNhưng đôi khi cũng có thể mong chờ một chút chứ. Dù sao mình cũng là Mã Nương mà.
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use canonical Mã Nương; current prose incorrectly retains Uma Musume.

decisions.proposed_text: Giờ đây, bản giao hưởng tựa dải ngân hà xa xôi vang vọng.\nĐể giành lại ánh sao trong bóng tối, hãy lao đi như sao chổi — “Mã Nương vũ trụ”.
decisions.reason: Generic 宇宙赛马娘 still contains forbidden Uma Musume; canonical world/species term is Mã Nương.
Open context-rule finding explicitly excludes generic phrase 放声欢呼 from false Gran Alegria character-name matching.
Open context-rule finding explicitly excludes hashtag/prose 心动 from Skill-title matching.
Open context-rule finding explicitly identifies 充满力量 here as ordinary prose describing powerful music, not gameplay Power.
